column1: # Bottom layer for tests/cxraw.cx and tests/cxinclude.cx: path prefixes (ending in /) or exact
# paths whose direct libc/POSIX calls and #include directives are the adapters themselves and are
# The layer is a directory boundary: cx/sys/ cx/mem/ cx/text/ are L0, everything else is L1 and
# must reach libc only through them.  A file that needs libc belongs in one of those three, not on
# an exact-entry line below -- an exact entry is a single documented exception, and its reason
# goes in tests/cxinclude-boundary.tsv for #include and in the "why" comment here for calls.
# host bootstrap: the two files that start a product build before any module exists.
# header-surface probes: they exist to exercise a carried header, so migrating them to sys.*
# would delete the test (reasons in tests/cxinclude-boundary.tsv).
